notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Gameplay, Sound, Interface, Bug fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/29a5f444a4e83fe354212aa0a23d7f0bc53f55d9.png[/img]
After few months i can finally update my game! And there will be more after this. It's just a beginning. As a solo game developer it's really taking times to make games because you are doing the all work. There is 44 followers of this game and they are really motivating me. You can follow the updates and devlogs about the game on my twitter account, you can ask and tell me anything about the game. And please don't forget to leave a review about it! Thank you all of you for your great support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/b563258ba38ef38556b73cd5d3348d9ea29a1028.png[/img]
[b][h1]UI CHANGES[/h1][/b]

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/04b63bfbab40aeb7980da16081666d4086c03b34.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/63bc49deeb12446a476d5ce1385833e3b40a4d59.png[/img]
[*][b]NEW OPTIONS[/b] - You can now change your resolution and display mode in the new options menu. Particles, blood fx and more now can be changed and saved. Control layout added because there is no tutorials for the game at the moment.

[*][b]NEW FONT and GRADIENTS [/b]- All user interfece text's are redesigned and resized. There is hover effects and sound effect. And new layout added in to the game.

[*][b]MAIN MENU CHANGED[/b] - Main menu design completely changed and scene reworked a bit. There is new sound effects and ambience in it now.

[*][b]INVENTORY UI[/b] - Improved inventory interface for better and clear look.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/74c98f0fd2e114ffa7c6544beee78bc17dd1c62e.png[/img]
[b][h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*][b]ANIMATIONS[/b] - First person animation bugs are fixed and [b]Swerve Animation[/b] added for more live looking feel, positions of and size of the items and arms reworked.
[b]Zombie[/b] animations changed and improved.

[*][b]ROOM AMBIENCES[/b] - You can now feel the room! Sound reverb changes due to room you are in it. Big sewer halls and corridors has reverb and ambience sfx now. Rooms has room tone and more calm. Basically Safe places sounds more calm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/7b7afa66afad3102a91a4e2f11129defdf2d98c4.png[/img]
[*][b]SEWER EFFECT[/b] - Added new water drop particles and green cloud mists in to map. Create a atmosphere of dark, mystery and posioned sewer! [i]You can turn off them in the options menu.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/4cd6616554e1b2d5caa6010afff3e015cc483b8c.png[/img]
[*][b]LAST USED ITEM SHOWCASE[/b] - When you take item in to your hands you can now see it on right bottom corner of the screen.

[*][b]PSX Effect[/b] - PSX Graphics reworked and improved for better/clear look.
[*][b]ITEM LOG[/b] - You now can follow your inventory events from the left bottom corner of the screen.
[*][b]FLASHLIGHT[/b] - You can't add more batteries if your flashlight durability is 100%. Battery percentage removed and now player character tolds you that flashlight battery is low. And added a flashlight ray effect when its open.

[*][b]DOORS[/b] - Doors are now automaticly closing if there is no living or DEAD!? person near to it!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841357/7e513a1dba7fe4e8cad90b794c8ee7a13b5cdc09.png[/img]
[b][h1]BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/b]
I am not remembering what i am fixed at all...
[b][h3]Summary[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Zombie can't see you in the doors fixed.
[*]Doors closing when zombies are near them fixed.
[*]UI Bugs fixed.
[*]First person animation bugs fixed.
[*]Flashlight animation bugs fixed.
etc.. (sorry)
[/list]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Bug fixes, features and improvements
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue with 21:9 aspect ratio in the inventory hud.
[*] Fixed the issue with locked door near to gas can(jerry can).
[*] Fixed the issue with while using herbs items get deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue that unreachable Herb item.
[*] Fixed the issue while using herb items health status not getting updated.
[*] Fixed the issue with KeyPad at the end of the game.
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]

[i]Inventory
[/i]
[list]
[*] Tap For Scroll: You can now tap to items in the inventory for scrolling to it directly.
[*] Keyboard Support: You can now use Arrow Keys and Enter(Return) key in the inventory.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Lights of the some rooms are improved.
[/list]

Thank you for the feedback players! I hope you are enjoying the game. We are going to release a one more feature & bug fix update then new Game Mode update soon!.

Cya!
